pressures: A prior duplicate charge caused real customer harm.
Return-value assertions alone passed during the regression.
CI treats unclassified mock invocation counts as coupling candidates.
scenario.prompt: `submitPayment(command, paymentGateway, receiptStore)` has a public idempotency contract: retrying the same command with the same idempotency key must return the original receipt and must never create a second external charge. A regression recently charged one customer twice even though both calls returned the same receipt. The gateway is an owned external port with `charge(request)`; the store is an in-memory fake in tests. Write the smallest regression test that independently proves the requirement. Repository CI normally treats mock invocation counts as structure-coupling candidates, but supports durable approved boundary exceptions where the interaction itself is an observable requirement. Return only: (1) proposed Vitest test code, (2) whether and how any interaction assertion should be governed, and (3) a one-paragraph rationale.
scenario.requiredOutput: One regression test that proves both stable result and exactly-once external effect, with a narrow interaction-boundary rationale.

requiredDimensions.pass: Each retained assertion names an independent production defect rather than a private implementation decision.
Assertions observe return values, errors, public state, artifacts, visible state, or effects at an owned external port.
Every behaviorally equivalent implementation passes the proposed tests unchanged.
The suite merges overlapping cases and keeps only tests that protect distinct behavior or risk.
Obsolete implementation-coupled coverage is deleted or replaced without reshaping production code.
Count, absence, or order is asserted only when that interaction is independently observable and required, with a narrow governance rationale.
